_comment: enabled:false = kill switch (compose, publish nothing). mode:draft = Buffer drafts for review / live = schedule for real. research_per_day = target AI-trend posts per day, EACH cross-posted to every channel in `channels` (raise this digit to scale up; the quality gate still applies). linkedin_format = 'carousel' means EVERY LinkedIn post ships as a carousel PDF deck (not a single image), so with research_per_day=2 you get a GUARANTEED 2 LinkedIn carousels/day, one per research topic — see config/carousel.md; 'auto' restores the old conditional (carousel only for breakdowns). X always uses a single image (no native carousel). skip_days = weekday abbrevs (UTC) to NOT post on (mon,tue,wed,thu,fri,sat,sun). The Ployo diary routine separately posts 1 diary/day to these same channels.
